name: green-level-tracked-label
note: G-LIVE §2.1. A tracked label's template args sample at the SAME bar as the price, so the text cannot print a stale number. {price} over high[4]=17 renders '17.00' (formatDrawNumber's two-decimal, round-half-even form); an untracked label would read 'H 13.00'.
source:
indicator("T", shorttitle="T", overlay=true)
plotlevel(bar_index == 1, high, "TR", track=true, extend=extend.lastbar, max_kept=1, label="H {price}")
